messages:
ela (DevEx): New-hire pairing just hit a README Ruby example that crashes immediately. Looks like cross-language snippets drifted after the API split. filing here so we can fix quickly.
noah (SDK): bummer. which snippet?
ela (DevEx): README shows this Ruby block under "Quickstart":
```rb
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Hello')
puts resp.text
```
ela (DevEx): runtime: NoMethodError: undefined method `generate' for #<Redwood::Client:0x000...>. Also our env examples in the README use REDACTED_API_KEY in several places.
noah (SDK): we renamed and unified the env var to RW_API_KEY in v0.9 and split chat/completions. The Ruby client now exposes Redwood::Client#chat.create (or #chat_generate depending on binding). Docs should show before/after. Also note: retry default changed to 0; examples should set retry explicitly to avoid 429 surprises.
ririe (docs): thanks. I'll open a PR to update Ruby/JS/Python snippets with before/after, replace placeholders, and add a small migration note at the top of quickstart. I'll also add a short paragraph warning about copy/pasting placeholder keys into deployments.
ela (DevEx): can we also add a CI lint that scans code fences for placeholder tokens /(REDACTED|YOUR_KEY|PLACEHOLDER)/i and fails? Caught it locally but CI would be great.
noah (SDK): good idea. I'll add a runtime guard in the Ruby SDK to detect legacy env names (REDWOOD_KEY, OLD_API_KEY) and raise a helpful error pointing to RW_API_KEY. We can deprecate for one minor release then remove.
ririe (docs): created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921 "docs: fix quickstart snippets (ruby) + migration note + placeholder linter"
ci-bot: triggered examples-smoke across node/python/ruby for branch docs/fix-readme-ruby (workflow: examples-smoke).
ci-bot: examples-smoke failed (run 101): detected placeholder "REDACTED_API_KEY" in README -> blocking merge (good).
ririe (docs): replaced placeholders with instructions: export RW_API_KEY=your_real_key and added the linter step to GH actions. Also added a before/after Ruby snippet: 
```rb
# before (outdated)
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Hello')
puts resp.text

# after (updated)
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['RW_API_KEY'], retry: { max_retries: 2 })
resp = client.chat.create(messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }])
puts resp.choices.first.message.content
```
ci-bot: examples-smoke passed (run 102). Ruby/Node/Python examples executed against staging fixtures.
noah (SDK): merged a tiny SDK patch that prints a helpful error if legacy env vars are detected. Planning a follow-up to emit a deprecation warning before removal.
ela (DevEx): great. let's add a checklist item in onboarding to run the examples smoke locally so new hires validate quickstart. small snippet drift like this is high friction for first-run DX.
ririe (docs): PR merged and backported to release/v0.9.x. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
